    Buy or Build Homes in Parrish, Florida

    Experience incredible amenities, vibrant neighborhoods, and plenty of nearby shopping and activities. Parrish sets the standard for luxury living - no matter your stage of life.

    Experience the Best of Parrish Living

    Designed with your lifestyle in mind.

    Parrish, Florida blends small-town charm with modern convenience, offering everything you need to live well - right at your doorstep. From lively town centers and resort-style pools to golf courses, tennis courts, clubhouses, and restaurants, every day here feels like a vacation.

    ​

    With a diverse range of homes to match every budget and life stage - whether you're starting a family or looking for a 55+ retreat - Parrish has a neighborhood that fits you perfectly. And with community events and amenities designed to bring people together, life here is all about enjoying the moment and making the most of every day.

    Compare Neighborhoods
    Compare Neighborhoods

    Aberdeen

    Aberdeen is a quaint, established neighborhood that features two playgrounds, picnic areas and gorgeous mature trees. Walking trails here are great for walking, running or biking.

    Bella Lago

    Bella Lago is a neighborhood built by D.R. Horton that offers new single family homes and resort-style living. Amenities include a clubhouse, pool, fitness center, dog park, year-round events, a playground, and more.

    Chelsea Oaks

    Chelsea Oaks is a gated, established neighborhood offering single-family homes with a stunning lot layout. Amenities include a resort-style pool with waterslides, playground, basketball court, an outdoor amphitheater, and more.

    Creekside Preserve

    Creekside Preserve offers a gated community experience with no CDD fees. amenities include a playground and a basketball court - with easy access to nearby parks.

    Crosswind

    Crosswind offers lakeside living in Parrish and also features a community pool, playgrounds, walking trails, and an upcoming amenity center with pickleball courts and a dog park.

    Firethorn

    Firethorn features brand-new open-concept homes ranging from 1,400 to 3,800 sq. ft. The vacation-inspired amenities include a sparkling pool, state-of-the-art fitness center, outdoor movement studio, and courts for pickleball, tennis, and basketball, offering endless ways to enjoy the Florida sunshine with family and friends.

    Gamble Creek Estates

    Gamble Creek Estates is a peaceful established neighborhood with beautiful walking trails by the lake and forest preserves. Amenities here include a playground and a basketball/pickleball court.

    Isles at BayView

    Isles at Bayview is a newer Parrish neighborhood offering new construction single family homes and resort-style amenities. With a pool, clubhouse, dog park, and plenty more, it blends convenience and community for today’s homebuyer.

    Lakeside Preserve

    Lakeside Preserve is a small, established community that offers breathtaking lakeside views along with family friendly amenities including new pickleball courts and a playground.

    McKinley Oaks

    McKinley Oaks is a small, upscale community in Parrish, FL, with large homes and park-like settings.

    Parkwood Lakes

    Parkwood Lakes is a beautifully designed and landscaped non-gated community in Parrish. Established with no CDD fees, Parkwood Lakes offers quality single family homes, lake views and preserve views on an impressive lot layout.

    River Wilderness

    River Wilderness is a luxury golfing community in Parrish. Covering over 1,500 acres, this established neighborhood offers a wide range of premium amenities including pickleball, a fitness center, clubhouse dining and more.

    Rye Crossing

    Rye Crossing is a new gated community being built by D.R. Horton. It features a variety of one-story and two-story houses and has all sorts of family friendly amenities including a community pool, fitness center, a dog park, playground, tennis, pickleball, bocce ball and more.

    Sawgrass Lakes

    Sawgrass Lakes is a new family-friendly neighborhood in Parrish that is based on a lakeside lot layout and surrounded by a countryside landscape. Amenities for this community include a community pool and playground.

    Southern Oaks

    Southern Oaks is a small, quiet community tucked into Parrish's forests and lakes. This family-friendly neighborhood features one-story and two-story homes combined with amenities like a community pool, walking paths, a dog park and playground.

    The Towns at Firethorn

    The Towns at Firethorn offers new townhomes ranging with four thoughtfully designed floor plans (Ivy, Hazel, Jasmine, Marigold). These open-concept homes feature spacious kitchens, designer finishes, and amenities like a pool, dog park and playground - all built by Taylor Morrison.

    Windwater

    Windwater is a gated, coastal-inspired community by Mattamy Homes. This neighborhood features stunning new construction homes along with a community pool, dog park and playground.

    Ancient Oaks

    Ancient Oaks is a quiet, established neighborhood offering larger lots, beautiful walking trails and close proximity to Buffalo Creek Park - giving residents with access to a dog park, walking trails, soccer fields and more.

    Broadleaf

    Broadleaf is a new construction community by SimplyDwell Homes that features gorgeous single family homes. Amenities include a covered event pavilion and lawn, shaded playground and fenced dog park.

    Copperstone

    Copperstone is a luxury gated community that has an amazing natural landscape that is also packed with amenities. Amenities include a clubhouse, fitness center, playgrounds, nature trails and more.

    Creekside at Rutland Ranch

    Creekside at Rutland Ranch by KB Home delivers affordable, no-CDD living in Parrish’s beautiful countryside. This new neighborhood has parks, pond overlooks, and sports fields to foster an active, nature-rich lifestyle.

    Del Webb Sunchase

    Del Webb Sunchase in Parrish, Florida is a gated 55+ active adult community offering resort-style living with a spacious clubhouse, fitness center, resort and lap pools, pickleball, bocce ball, multiple social gathering areas. The community features new construction single-family homes built for low-maintenance, active living.

    Forest Creek

    Forest Creek offers a private, gated neighborhood experience with plenty of mature trees and walking trails. Amenities including a clubhouse, pool, fitness center, dog park and more.

    Grand Oak Preserve

    Grand Oak Preserve is a small, quiet, established community tucked away in the Parrish countryside. It offers no-CDD fees and has affordable single-family homes.

    Kingsfield

    Kingsfield is an established neighborhood in Parrish that offers mature landscaping, affordably priced homes and amenities that include a community pool, playground, dog park and walking paths.

    Legacy Preserve

    Legacy Preserve is a new build community that offers perfect mix of outdoor amenities that includes a clubhouse, playground, pickleball, dog park a community pool and more.

    North River Ranch

    North River Ranch is a popular master-planned community in Parrish that offers resort-style amenities like pools, fitness centers, nature trails, a kayak launch and more. North River Ranch has sub-neighborhoods that all share common amenities but have their own builders and styles.

    Prosperity Lakes

    Prosperity Lakes is a new gated community that's packed with features and amenities. It has its own 55+ section, along with an impressive amenity package. Amenities include a clubhouse, community pool, fitness center, year-round events, trails, pickleball, tennis, bocce ball and more

    River Woods

    River Woods is a quiet neighborhood full of large mature trees - giving you privacy. Amenities here include a community pool and tennis/pickleball courts.

    Rye Ranch

    Rye Ranch is a new construction neighborhood being built by Lennar. This community is packed with amenities and will feature a clubhouse, community pool, fitness center, pickleball, tennis, bocce ball and more.

    Seaire

    Seaire offers a huge array of new homes from several home builders. Amenities include a giant lagoon-style pool, year-round events, a dog park and more.

    Summerwoods

    Summerwoods offers a combination of established homes and new construction. The neighborhood features a community pool, splash pad, playground, dog park and walking trails.

    Timberly

    Timberly offers over 60 maintenance-free villas with a heated community pool, lawn care, and scenic lake views.

    Woodland Preserve

    Woodland Preserve is a new 55+gated community from Kolter Homes. Amenities include a clubhouse, community pool, fitness center, pickleball, bocce ball and more.

    Aviary at Rutland Ranch

    Aviary at Rutland Ranch offers a wide variety of new construction homes - blending resort-style perks with a beautiful lot layout. Amenities include a community pool, pickleball, dog park walking trails and more.

    Canoe Creek

    Canoe Creek offers new construction by Neal Communities - where residents enjoy brand new homes and a vast array of amenities. These include a lagoon-style pool, fitness center, pickleball courts, dog parks, year-round events and more.

    Creekside Oaks

    Creekside Oaks is a small, gated community that offers affordable established single-family homes in a peaceful setting.

    Cross Creek

    Cross Creek in Parrish blends an established community with brand-new home construction. Amenities include a lagoon-style pool with slide, splash pad, lakeside trails and more.

    Del Webb at BayView

    Del Webb at BayView gives you an incredible 55+ active adult community experience. World-class amenities here include a resort-style pool, fitness center, year-round events, tennis, pickleball, bocce ball and more.

    Foxbrook

    Foxbrook offers a true countryside experience - with large lot sizes and an open, pastoral landscape. Amenities here include a basketball court and playground.

    Harrison Ranch

    Harrison Ranch is a luxury neighborhood that is rich with expansive greenspaces and offers several amenities like a clubhouse, community pool, fitness center, tennis, pickleball and more.

    Kingsfield Lakes

    Kingsfield Lakes is a an established, family-friendly neighborhood offering one-story and two-story homes. Amenities include a community pool and playground.

    Lexington

    Lexington is a polished, established neighborhood that offers a variety of homes along with a nice amenities package. Amenities include a community pool, playground, pickleball courts, a basketball court and walking paths.

    Oakfield

    Oakfield offers a large variety of new construction homes complete with a wide array of amenities such as a clubhouse, community pool, fitness centers, tennis, pickleball and more. Oakfield is split into two sections - Oakfield Trails and Oakfield Lakes. Each one has its own builders and set of amenities.

    River Plantation

    River Plantation is a clean, beautiful neighborhood that's tucked into the forests of Parrish. Amenities are impressive here with a clubhouse, community pool, fitness center, walking trails, tennis, pickleball and more.

    River's Reach

    River's Reach is a beautiful gated community in Parrish that has stunning elongated lakes and preserve views. Amenities here include a clubhouse, fitness center, community pool, playground and greenspaces.

    Salt Meadows

    Salt Meadows offers beautiful new construction homes with a solid set of amenities for relaxing coastal living. Amenities include a clubhouse, community pool, fitness center, pickleball, playground and more.

    Silverleaf

    Silverleaf offers newer single-family homes and villas with a large amenities package. This gated neighborhood comes with a community pool, fitness center, trails, a dog park and more.

    The Islands on The Manatee River

    The Islands on The Manatee River is a gated, luxury community that offers high-end estates that have access to the Manatee River. Available lots invite buyers to 'bring their own builder' for a custom estate. Amenities include a clubhouse, pool, fitness center, tennis courts, and boat docks.

    Twin Rivers

    Twin Rivers is an established community that has large lots, riverside beauty and high-quality single-family homes. Amenities include a volleyball court, basketball court, playground and picnic area. You can also kayak the Manatee River at your leisure.
